caption:
The video depicts a person in a gray, blue, and red plaid button-up shirt working at a table on a large, glossy black sheet that mirrors the torso and the recording device. The right hand grips a green plastic squeegee and presses its edge onto the dark surface, while the left hand pinches the top edge to hold the sheet flat. The squeegee is already mid-stroke, drawn down from the upper region toward the bottom edge.

The squeegee lifts clear and is re-applied at the top. It is swept down again along the left half, then worked in short back-and-forth strokes that continue through the remaining motion. The holding hand stays at the top edge throughout, making only small adjustments, and the sheet remains laid flat. The workspace is bordered by pink-handled scissors and a curled white paper on the left. A red toad and a brown-and-gold monkey figurine sit on the right, with a rolled pale tube behind. Droplets remain visible near the sheet's edges, while the mirrored reflection of the shirt shifts across the glossy surface.
relations: Squeegee re-applied at top edge -> blade sweeps down left half in short back-and-forth strokes.
Left hand pinches top edge -> sheet stays flat while right hand strokes the surface.
Glossy black surface reflects torso -> mirrored shirt shifts as squeegee moves across it.
Droplets near sheet edges -> water remains visible as squeegee clears the surface.
